It is transferring its liquor license to the incoming Thai House Kitchen concept, which will replace it at the location. The article notes the restaurant remains open during this process.

Sweetwaters Coffee & Tea is a coffee and tea chain with 39 locations across the United States. A second Greater Houston location is planned for the Magnolia Woods Office Park at 923 Honea Egypt Road, with operator Arron Martin confirming a summer opening. The location is operated by franchisees Heather and Arron Martin, who also run a location at 9511 FM 1488.

data.status: currently targeting a 2027 opening, pending permits and final approvals
data.short_description: Huey Magoo's is a fast-casual chicken tender chain expanding its Texas footprint through a five-unit development agreement. Franchisee Bobby Asad, operating through Apex Hospitality Group, is targeting a 2027 opening pending permits and final approvals across Arlington, Grand Prairie, and Mansfield. Site selection is underway across approximately eight candidate sites in the three markets.

Olive Garden is a casual dining Italian-American chain operated by Olive Garden Holdings, LLC, a subsidiary of Darden Restaurants. A new location is planned at 2101 Claribel Road as part of the Crossroads West development, according to a liquor license application filed with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control. The restaurant will join other confirmed tenants at the 365,000-square-foot mixed-use retail center including Costco, Trader Joe's, and Raising Cane's.

data.location: 4150 Mission Blvd, Suite 113, San Diego, CA 92109
data.status: targeting a launch toward the end of summer
data.short_description: Tanta Roba Pizzeria is an Italian restaurant specializing in Roman-style pizza and Tuscan schiacciata sandwiches, founded by an Italian family. The concept is working through final permits and approvals ahead of a late-summer opening at 4150 Mission Boulevard, Suite 113, in San Diego's Pacific Beach neighborhood, in the former home of Coxinha Store. Owners Mattia and Alessandra plan to offer authentic Roman-style pizza by the slice, Tuscan schiacciata sandwiches, salads, and desserts using organic ingredients and imported Italian products.

data.location: 8940 Elk Grove Blvd, Elk Grove, CA 95624
data.status: planning to open the café's second location by the first week of July
data.short_description: Life's Grind is an independent coffee shop and community staple originally based in Galt, California. Co-owner Gurdeep Bains is planning to open the brand's second location at 8940 Elk Grove Blvd by the first week of July, marking the brand's first expansion outside its hometown. The 1,500-square-foot space will offer coffee drinks, mushroom coffee, matcha, smoothies, pastries, sandwiches, power bowls, avocado toast, and acai bowls.

data.status: slated to open by the end of 2026, with early 2027 as the latest possible target date
data.short_description: Talkin' Tacos is a Miami-born fast-casual Mexican food chain known for its birria tacos. The brand is expanding with a second Texas location at 2805 Main Street in Deep Ellum, Dallas, slated to open by the end of 2026 with early 2027 as the latest target. The chain entered Texas in 2024 with a Plano location at 8442 Parkwood Blvd.

Bar Siete is a new bar concept from chef Oswaldo Bibiano, the chef behind Smart Donkey Burreria, set to open at 3448 NE Sandy Blvd in the former home of Shaku Bar. The concept would mark Bibiano's first full bar concept, featuring Mexican-inspired cocktails, small plates, and a neighborhood-focused atmosphere. Shaku Bar closed in April according to the article.

Shaku Bar was a bar located at 3448 NE Sandy Blvd in Portland. It closed in April, and the space is being taken over by the incoming Bar Siete concept. The closure is mentioned as background context within the Bar Siete article.

data.status: expected an October or November opening date
data.short_description: Palmyra is a new "summer-centric" restaurant concept from owner Greg Karellas coming to 319 Front Street in downtown Lemont, in the former home of Next Mex. No estimated opening date has been set by the owner, though the article reports the community can expect an October or November opening. Karellas has previous restaurant experience as the minority owner of Hawthorne's Backyard in West Chicago.

Next Mex was an upscale Mexican restaurant and margarita bar that served the Lemont village for 15 years. It closed in November 2025, and the space was subsequently found by the team behind the incoming Palmyra concept. The closure is noted as background context in the Palmyra article.

data.location: 953 E Sahara Ave, Ste. E9, Las Vegas, NV 89109
data.status: plan is to open at the beginning of September
data.short_description: Binchotan is a new all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ concept specializing in pork, with no time limit on the dining experience. Owner Sean Liang plans to open the restaurant within the Historic Commercial Center District at 953 E Sahara Ave, Ste. E9, at the beginning of September if construction and permitting proceed on schedule. Liang has been in the meat industry for over a decade and is working with Chef's Steam Table to supply meats.

data.status: an opening timeline has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Tim Hortons is a Canadian quick-service restaurant chain operating more than 5,000 restaurants worldwide, known for coffee, doughnuts, and Timbits. A new location is proposed at 4097 Nolensville Pike in South Nashville, according to a recently filed permit, and would occupy a former Arby's building. No opening timeline has been announced as of publication.

Bar Belle is a new cocktail bar concept from Chef Joey Ward, set to open on a renovated side patio connected to Southern Belle and Georgia Boy in Poncey-Highland, Atlanta. The first-come, first-served concept will feature cocktails, raw bar items, and rotating small plates including a signature A-Town Burger. Both Bar Belle and Southern Belle Chicken Co. are expected to open in summer 2026.

Southern Belle Chicken Co. is a new fast-casual counter service concept from Chef Joey Ward, set to open inside CTR Food Works at 225 Central Avenue in downtown Atlanta. The menu will center on chicken-focused dishes with globally influenced flavors as part of the redevelopment of the former CNN Center. Both concepts are expected to open in summer 2026.

data.location: 8039 N Deering Ave, Canoga Park, CA 91303
data.status: getting ready to open a new brewpub
data.short_description: Lincoln Beer Company is a Burbank-based craft brewery founded by Patrick Dunn in 2016, planning to open a new brewpub at 8039 N. Deering Avenue in Canoga Park. The proposed location would include an 8,116-square-foot brewery and brewpub with 169 indoor seats and a 1,500-square-foot uncovered patio with 100 outdoor seats, pending a Conditional Use Permit from the Los Angeles City Planning Department. The company launched its production brewery in Burbank in 2016 followed by a public taproom in 2017.

data.status: targeting a late July to early August debut
data.short_description: Slava Cafe & Bakery is a Ukrainian-inspired cafe and bakery from owner and chef Svitlana Eadie, preparing to open at 37 Wall St. in downtown Asheville. The cafe will serve breakfast and lunch Wednesday through Sunday, with offerings including cabbage rolls, deruny, crepes, fresh breads, pastries, and coffee and espresso beverages. The upcoming cafe marks Eadie's first brick-and-mortar venture after years of operating Svitlana's Kitchen, a catering company.

data.status: an exact address and opening timeline have yet to be announced
data.short_description: Slutty Vegan is an Atlanta-based plant-based burger chain founded by Pinky Cole Hayes in 2018, expanding through a new franchise agreement in Atlanta. Franchisees Khadejah Davis and Jamel Douglas will operate the new location, becoming the first official Slutty Vegan franchise owners to open in Atlanta, though an exact address and opening timeline have not been announced. Davis and Douglas currently own multiple Juici Patties franchise locations.

data.status: leases have not yet been finalized
data.short_description: Southern Grounds & Co. is a Florida-based hybrid coffee shop, bakery, and restaurant concept founded in 2016 in Neptune Beach, Florida. The brand has signed letters of intent for locations in both Dilworth and Plaza Midwood in Charlotte, which would represent its first locations outside Florida, though leases have not yet been finalized and specific addresses and opening timelines have not been announced. The brand also operates alongside Blueberry Bakery, a companion concept that supplies baked goods for its cafés.

167 Sushi Bar is a Charleston dining destination and part of 167 Hospitality Group, operating an intimate 24-seat restaurant at 289 E. Bay St. The restaurant plans to move from 289 E. Bay St. to 5 Cumberland St. in early 2027, vacating the current E. Bay Street storefront. The group noted that the 289 E. Bay St. space will not go vacant permanently, with plans for a new concept to be announced later in the year.

data.status: plans to move from its intimate 24-seat restaurant at 289 E. Bay St. to 5 Cumberland St.

The new location will provide additional reservation capacity, a Japanese-inspired cocktail program, and expanded sushi and izakaya offerings. The move is planned for early 2027 according to an Instagram post from the restaurant.

Capitaine is a new restaurant concept preparing to open at 684 Greenwich St. in the West Village, in the former space of Libertine. Co-owners Cody Pruitt and Jacob Cohen still had time on their lease and are relaunching the space quickly, with Libertine's last day of service having been May 23, 2026. Details about the concept's menu and format have not yet been publicly shared as of publication.

data.status: the last day of service at Libertine having been May 23
data.short_description: Libertine was a West Village bistro located at 684 Greenwich St. that held its last day of service on May 23, 2026. Co-owners Cody Pruitt and Jacob Cohen still had time on their lease and are relaunching the space as a new concept called Capitaine. The rebranding appears to be a quick turnaround, with the official Libertine Instagram account already rebranded to Capitaine.

Big Papa's Empanadas is a counter-service restaurant from owner and chef Jonathan Leonard, focusing on oversized empanadas in a variety of sweet and savory flavors. The restaurant is preparing to open at 1812 Rozzelles Ferry Road in Charlotte, with Leonard targeting an August debut. Leonard is a Johnson & Wales University graduate who also operates Freshly Cracked, a meal-prep and catering business that will be incorporated into the new restaurant.

data.location: 257 W Clarkston Rd, Lake Orion, MI 48362
data.status: expected to debut in the next couple months
data.short_description: Shaded Bloom Coffee Roasters is a Southeast Michigan family-owned SCA certified wholesale roaster run by Erica and Derrick Kratt. The owners are working with the team at Lake Orion Sports Center to open a new full sit-down cafe at 257 W Clarkston Road in Lake Orion, with an official opening date not yet announced but expected in the next couple of months. The business previously operated a location in Clarkston.

Danny's Cafe is a family-owned restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, dinner, and catering services. The business is relocating from its current downtown Burlington location at 110 W. Front Street to a larger space on South Church Street. The old location's closing date has not been specified in the article.

Danny's Cafe is a family-owned restaurant combining restaurant, catering, and event services under one roof. The new 7,000-square-foot location at 2461 S. Church Street is targeting an August 1 opening, per co-owner Tyler Lackey. The new space will include a private event space, juice bar, coffee bar, and mocktail menu, and is expected to employ approximately 35 full-time and part-time team members.

Jeff's Bagel Run is a Central Florida-born scratch-made bagel shop expanding throughout Florida and other states via franchise. A second Pinellas County location is planned for 2325 Ulmerton Road, Unit 1, in the Feather Sound Square business center in Clearwater, replacing a former OB/GYN office. Local franchisee Tony Trunzo plans to renovate the 1,320-square-foot storefront into a bagel shop with limited indoor seating.

data.status: expects to open just weeks after final approval
data.short_description: Lockheart Restaurant is a Southwestern-inspired dining concept known for tacos, nachos, quesadillas, empanadas, and craft cocktails. It is taking over the historic former railroad station at 70 Union Street in Newton Centre, beside the Green Line stop, with the applicants' attorney stating the team expects to open just weeks after state ABCC approval. The Board of License Commissioners unanimously approved its license on June 16, pending submission of outstanding documents and final state approval.

Mixteca is a modern agave bar and restaurant led by hospitality veterans Jeff Bell and Victor Lopez, expanding beyond its flagship New York City location. The Philadelphia location will open at 2113 E. York St. in East Kensington, taking over the former Martha space, with a planned July opening. The location will feature housemade tortillas, tacos, large-format dishes, a balcony overlooking the dining room, and a dedicated private dining space.

Sugarita Coffee Shop & Bakery is a new brick-and-mortar expansion of Sugarita Cake Couture, a Dominican cake and artisan cake catering operation. Plan review documents place the new bakery at 6010 County Rd 579 S in Seffner, at the address of Masters Inn Seffner. The new location is described as a bakery, coffee shop, and small consignment store, with menu details not yet available.

Haraz Coffee House is a Yemeni coffee shop serving traditional Yemeni coffee and tea, espresso-based drinks, pastries, and Middle Eastern desserts. The franchise owners plan to open a new location at 1822 Chestnut St. in the Rittenhouse Square neighborhood of Philadelphia. The space is a bi-level historic building that will include private rentable space and exclusive menu items not available at other locations.

data.status: does not yet have an opening date
data.short_description: Agnes is a new restaurant concept named after its street address, being developed by the team behind Selden Standard — Evan Hansen and Andy Hollyday. The team has signed a lease at 8047 Agnes Street in West Village, Detroit, but Hansen has confirmed no opening date has been set yet. The concept also includes chef de cuisine Alex Jull from Takoi and Selden Standard manager Paul Fradeneck overseeing day-to-day operations.

data.status: tentative soft opening set for June 29, 2026
data.short_description: Paris Baguette is a South Korean bakery-café chain offering French- and Asian-inspired pastries, breads, cakes, and coffee. The Bellingham location at 253 Hartford Avenue is the flagship of an eight-unit Massachusetts expansion by franchisees Ankur Sahni and Megha Arora-Sahni, with a tentative soft opening set for June 29, 2026 and a grand opening to follow pending final inspections. The nearly 4,300-square-foot location will be adjacent to Whole Foods.

data.status: slated as the next location, with a target opening ahead of the holiday season
data.short_description: Paris Baguette is a South Korean bakery-café chain expanding across Massachusetts via franchisees Ankur Sahni and Megha Arora-Sahni. The Mansfield location is slated as the second opening in the state, with a target opening ahead of the holiday season, though an address has not yet been announced. The franchisees plan to open a total of eight cafés across the Greater Boston area in the coming years.

data.location: 923 E. Seminary Drive, Fort Worth, TX 76115
data.status: closing its current location on June 21
data.short_description: Ribbee's is a rib-focused barbecue restaurant founded by three of the owners of Goldee's BBQ, operating at 923 E. Seminary Drive in East Fort Worth for just over two years. The restaurant announced it will close its current location on June 21, 2026, citing a change in property ownership as the reason, with the new property owners planning to open their own restaurant in the space. The owners stated they are searching for a new location and hope to reopen the concept in the future.

data.status: closing our doors permanently at the end of next month
data.short_description: Burger Up is a longtime Nashville restaurant serving specialty burgers, loaded fries, salads, soups, and beverages, founded in 2010. The restaurant announced on Instagram that it will permanently close on August 1, 2026, its last day of service, after 16 years in business. No official reason for the closure has been shared by the restaurant team.

La Popular is an upscale Mexican dining concept serving Mexico City-inspired cuisine alongside an agave-focused beverage program and handcrafted cocktails. The restaurant will open its newest Southern California location at 32 Al Harris Lane in Redlands on Monday, June 22, 2026. The concept is known for its artisan spirits, traditional Mexican dishes, and a lively atmosphere celebrating Mexico City culture.

Ochoa Mexican Grill is a new Tex-Mex dining concept from Olde Towne Partners, the ownership group behind Olde Towne Tavern and other Columbus-area hospitality ventures. The restaurant is planned for 113 E Main St. in Downtown Columbus, taking over the former Pecan Penny's space, with the ownership team targeting a Summer 2026 debut and expecting to reveal a firm opening timeline in July. The space will feature two large patios, multiple fire pits, and an open-air-inspired dining experience.

data.status: expected to celebrate its grand opening in early August
data.short_description: The Monarch House is a new coffeehouse and wine bar concept founded by local entrepreneur Heather Barrow, planned for the historic Flatiron Building at 1833 Sycamore Street in Mount Auburn, Cincinnati. The concept is expected to celebrate its grand opening in early August, occupying the first-floor space previously home to Flatiron Cafe, which closed in January 2025. The 4,000-square-foot space will offer coffee, craft cocktails, beer, wine, breakfast sandwiches, pizza bagels, and light bites, initially operating Monday through Saturday from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.

data.status: plans to open The Belt in July
data.short_description: The Belt is a new food concept from partners Brandon Sakelaridos, Mike Dalewitz, and Joel Rosenthal, offering hand-carved deli-style sandwiches and smash burgers at Quaker Bridge Mall in Lawrenceville. The team plans to open in July at Quaker Bridge Mall, 3320 US-1, as the concept's first location. Two distinct sub-brands — The Belt: Hand Carved and Smashed by The Belt — will share one counter in the space.

Spot Lite is a multipurpose bar, gallery, record store, coworking space, and coffee shop (Cairo Coffee) located in Detroit's Islandview neighborhood, owned by Roula David and Jesse Cory. Owners announced the closure on social media, with Spot Lite's final day of business set for June 28, 2026. The owners cited a decision to "close this chapter in our lives and move away from nightlife" as the reason, without sharing a more specific cause.

UFO Bar is a 16-year-old bar located at 2110 Trumbull in Detroit's Corktown neighborhood, originally known as UFO Factory, taken over by Roula David in 2024. The bar's final day of business is scheduled for June 30, 2026, per the owners' social media announcement. The owners did not share a specific reason for closure, stating they are moving away from nightlife.

data.location: 200 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: Shabu Shack is a Japanese-style hot pot restaurant chain with locations in the Sacramento region, with its South San Francisco location being the brand's only Bay Area outpost. The restaurant confirmed through a social media post on June 17 that its final day of service will be June 22, 2026, marking the end of its Bay Area presence. No reason for the closure was publicly shared.

Jack's All Day is a new American restaurant inspired by classic Americana through the lens of Broadway, located at 731 8th Ave in the Times Square area of Midtown Manhattan. The restaurant offers modern American fare including Baked Clams Casino, a Rainbow Trout Club Sandwich, and a full bar, and will seat 68 guests with hours from 4:30 p.m. to 11 p.m. Tuesday to Sunday. The interior was designed by Broadway set designer David Korins, known for Hamilton and Beetlejuice, featuring an astroturfed ceiling and mid-century American décor.

data.location: 3215 S Rancho Dr, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.status: will open its largest location yet on July 3
data.short_description: Museum of Ice Cream is an immersive ice cream-themed entertainment brand with existing locations in New York, Miami, Chicago, Boston, and Singapore. The Las Vegas location will open on July 3 at AREA15's Zone 2, occupying a new 30,000-square-foot space with 14 immersive experiences, unlimited ice cream, and tickets starting at $42. Highlights include a two-story Sprinkle Pool, five slides, a tattoo parlor, a wedding chapel, and an all-you-can-eat ice cream buffet with more than 20 flavors.

data.location: 6435 S Rainbow Blvd, Ste. 102, Las Vegas, NV 89118

Per a Clark County permit, a new location is expected to open inside the Rainbow Sunset Pavilion at 6435 S Rainbow Blvd, Ste. 102, with owner Steve Shearer confirming a summer opening. The brand first opened in early 2024 and has since expanded to Fashion Show Mall and Allegiant Stadium.

data.short_description: Portland Spirit is planning to open a full-service, casual family-friendly restaurant inside the historic Rose Building at 1020 SW Naito Pkwy in Tom McCall Waterfront Park, pending city approval. Owner Dan Yates confirmed the company has filed an early assistance application with Portland Parks & Recreation and is targeting spring 2027 to be up and running. The proposal includes $2 million in renovations, a walk-up food window off Salmon Springs Plaza, and approximately 5,000 square feet of outdoor seating.

Candente Heights is a Tex-Mex restaurant from Sambrooks Hospitality, known for mesquite-wood fire-grilled fajitas and craft cocktails. The plan is to open at 2020 Lawrence Street in the Houston Heights neighborhood in 2027. This will be the third location for the Candente chain, following openings in Houston and Bellaire.

data.short_description: Fresh Brew Coffee and Tea is a major family-owned coffee and tea manufacturer planning a 262,120-square-foot facility for storage, packaging, brewing, and distribution. The new facility is expected to open in the Imperial Oaks Shopping Center at 21502 Rayford Rd, with construction slated to start in August and wrap up at the beginning of May 2027. FreshBrew Group acquired the branded licensed division of White Coffee Corporation in 2025 to expand its retail portfolio.

The brand has continued expanding across the Las Vegas Valley, with its fourth location having opened last year.

data.short_description: Jimmy John's is a sandwich chain known for freshly sliced meats and fresh-baked bread, part of the Inspire Brands portfolio. A new location is set to open inside the Travel Centers of America at 4808 N. McCarty Street, with construction slated to wrap up by mid-October 2026. Dunkin' will also undergo renovations at the same location as part of an estimated $1.2 million construction project.

Dunkin' is a coffee and donut chain with more than 14,000 locations worldwide, also part of Inspire Brands. The existing Dunkin' at 4808 N. McCarty Street is undergoing renovations as part of a $1.2 million construction project. Construction has just started and is slated to wrap up by mid-October 2026.

CEO Will Choi confirmed the restaurant plans to open at 2301 E. Broad Street, Suite 101 in Mansfield in November or December 2026. The new store is part of a broader growth period, with the brand planning multiple locations over the next 12 months.

Taco-n-ganas is a Memphis-area Mexican chain known for customizable burritos, quesadillas, and tacos. The chain is opening its first drive-thru location at 8079 Trinity Road in Cordova, in the space that previously housed Back Yard Burgers. This will be the brand's second Cordova storefront and joins ten existing locations across the greater Memphis area.

Tiger Hospitality also operates several other brands including Cosmos Burger and La Vida.

The brand currently has one open location in Carlsbad, with additional openings rolling out across Southern California.

The team is hoping to open the concept at 14 W Michigan Avenue in downtown Ypsilanti in spring 2027. The multi-level venue is being debuted by entrepreneur Michael Lloyd in partnership with local business advocate Stewart Beal.

data.short_description: Degthai is a Nashville-based Thai restaurant serving Thai street food-inspired dishes including pad thai, curries, and spring rolls, which first launched as a food truck in 2011. Owner Jay Jenratha confirmed the restaurant is nearing the finish line and awaiting final permit approvals before opening at 750 West Main Street in Hendersonville. The new location will occupy the former Trattoria La Caverna space and will feature expanded outdoor seating.

data.short_description: Zellers is a Canadian retail brand known for its department store format and revived nostalgic experiences, preparing to expand with multiple standalone Ontario locations. The Toronto store at 80 Orfus Road opens June 18, 2026 as a 25,000-square-foot standalone format. Alongside retail merchandise, the opening will feature the "Zellers Diner on Wheels," a traveling food truck concept tied to store openings.

data.short_description: Zellers is a Canadian retail brand expanding with standalone locations across Ontario as part of its return to brick-and-mortar retail. A Windsor location at Tecumseh Mall is planned for July 2026. Additional locations are also being explored in Brampton and Scarborough.

The brand is preparing to open a new location at 8855 Villa La Jolla Drive, Suite 490 in La Jolla, moving into Sprinkles' former space in The Shops at La Jolla Village. A filing indicating early development activity was recently submitted to the San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality.

data.location: 1505 Charleston Hwy., Suite E, West Columbia, SC 29169
data.short_description: Key Deli & Ice Cream Shop is a new comfort food venture from owner Kechia Bass, offering loaded hot dogs, deli sandwiches, Philly cheesesteaks, ice cream, and a coffee program. The shop will debut at 1505 Charleston Hwy., Suite E in the Granby Village Shopping Center in West Columbia. Bass also owns Key Insurance and Tax Services in the same plaza and intends to bring back the spirit of a former eatery, Sandy's Famous Hot Dogs, with her own additions.

data.status: expected to open toward the end of July
data.short_description: Saigon Alley Kitchen & Bar is a new Vietnamese restaurant and bar concept from the family behind Pho Ca Dao Vietnamese Kitchen, featuring classic Vietnamese dishes, Asian fusion offerings, and a full bar program. The restaurant is set to open at 3687 5th Ave in Hillcrest, in the former home of Two Seven Eight. Owner Duke Huynh confirmed the end-of-July target opening date.

Thunder Burgerz West is a locally owned American comfort-food restaurant concept founded by Roy Trantham, serving burgers, chicken tenders, hot dogs, pizza, salads, and ice cream. The restaurant is preparing to open at 521 Haywood Road in West Asheville, with Trantham describing work on the new location as progressing. An opening date has not yet been announced.

data.location: 6833 W. Sam Houston Pkwy S #103, Houston, TX 77072
data.short_description: Sambal Chef is a Malaysian restaurant in Houston's Chinatown specializing in beef rendang, roti canai, sambal fried rice, and curry dishes. The restaurant will permanently close on June 28, 2026, as the owners chose not to renew the lease after the property was sold and the new owner plans to use the space for a different business. The restaurant first opened in Pearland in 2021 before relocating to Houston's Chinatown in 2024.

data.location: 825 N Harbor Drive, Ste 109, San Diego, CA 92101
data.short_description: Board & Brew is a sandwich chain known for handcrafted sandwiches and its signature Secret Sauce, operated in this location by the Blacktop Restaurant Group. The restaurant has opened its newest location in the Midway District at 825 N Harbor Drive inside the new RaDD Building, offering handcrafted sandwiches, wraps, salads, and 12 craft beers on draft. The 2,000-square-foot space includes indoor seating, a patio, and outdoor bar seating with views of the Midway District and the USS Midway Museum.

Quaker Steak & Lube is a wing and automotive-themed restaurant that opened its Pinellas Park location in 2003, becoming a familiar local landmark. The restaurant will serve its final customers on July 5, 2026, after more than two decades in the area. The closure was announced on social media by General Manager Hillary Smith, though no specific reason was given in the official post.

Hob Nob Hill is one of San Diego's longest-running independent restaurants, known for made-from-scratch cooking and an in-house bakery, with roots dating back to 1944.
